text:
Avoid this dental clinic at all costs. There's absolutely no need to choose one just because they speak another language.

The receptionists are clueless, and the dentists are completely unprofessional. As mentioned in other reviews, they won't accept any treatment other than what they recommend, and they'll pretend to schedule your appointments only to repeatedly reschedule them without notice, making you wait for months.

Don't trust them when they say they'll contact you later to confirm your appointment. Three times, I waited, and no one ever got back to me.

Even when you call to schedule an appointment yourself, the clinic will cancel on you on the day of the appointment. This happened despite them confirming the time earlier that day, only for them to cancel shortly after due to their own convenience.

If this were another country, a clinic this terrible would be out of business in no time. And as further proof of their greed, they push you to register on LINE, claiming it will get you discounts, but unless you specifically point it out at every payment, they won’t apply the discount—a clear scam. Everything about this clinic is awful.

text:
I went in because I had a toothache. They couldn't treat me right away, so I was prescribed painkillers until my next visit and sent home.

When I went back later, I found out that the painkillers I'd been prescribed had caused my blood pressure to exceed 200, and they insisted that they couldn't treat me unless my blood pressure went down. Without a single apology, the doctor simply turned me away.

My blood pressure went down when I stopped taking the painkillers, but despite the result being my own prescribing error, the doctor's cold attitude of abandoning the patient without a second thought and showing no sign of empathy was a culture shock that would never happen in Japan.

The lack of responsibility and lack of awareness of human rights that causes problems made me realize that even though Thailand appears to be developed on the surface, it is still a developing country deep down.

If you go to this dental clinic, I recommend you be prepared to assume the risks yourself.

text:
I had tartar removed during my regular checkup.

Everything went well until the tartar removal,
but the dentist kindly informed me that I had a cavity,
so I decided to go ahead and treat it.

During the treatment,
the treatment was so sloppy that I started to feel increasingly uneasy.
The final brushing machine after the treatment also seemed very rough
(so rough I thought it was drawing on my teeth).

Sure enough, after I got home,
the treated area was extremely painful.
I couldn't even drink anything.
And it felt awful (rough).
To top it off, I couldn't floss.
I can't floss...lol.

I hadn't felt any pain before the treatment,
but I somehow felt like the treatment had gotten worse.

It was so painful,
I had an interpreter explain it to me during my second appointment,
and they decided to redo the same area.

After the redo,
I was able to floss,
but it seems the dentist isn't very good at adjusting my bite?
This time my bite is misaligned.
After I got home, I started having severe toothache again.
My teeth hurt so much that chewing is painful.
I also have a headache and a fever.
It's gotten worse and worse.

I'm going to another hospital right away.

This hospital
gives you a small discount and a free Dentis set if you write a review!
I don't need Dentis, so
I just wanted proper treatment.

To everyone who's having trouble choosing a dentist,
please make sure to choose your dentist carefully.
He just speaks Japanese, and he might be a guinea pig for a young doctor to gain experience ♪
